environment.description: Node.js 18 Express application deployed on ECS Fargate with PostgreSQL RDS. The database has RLS policies defined but the application connects using a superuser role (postgres) which bypasses RLS. The app.current_tenant session variable is set but the RLS policy uses `current_setting('app.current_tenant')` which is ignored for superuser connections. No input validation on query parameters.

config.rls_policy: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON documents USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant'))
config.network: VPC with public ALB, no WAF
